args.summary: Completed only the original Stage 8 development-plan deliverable: docs/DEVPLAN.md contains ordered unpowered/first-power/load/corner/orientation/inrush/fault/recovery steps, actual existing-pad probe locations, uncertainty-aware acceptance/evidence matrix, risk owners, stop/energy holds and an approval-gated five-PCB/three-assembly prototype quote plan. Native placement/routing DRC retains four intrinsic J1 hole_clearance findings; historical raw DRC is not zero and fabrication resolution remains mandatory. Hardware/BOM/export sources and real firmware NOT APPLICABLE status are unchanged. No prototype has been ordered, manufactured or tested; current/cost budgets and every physical qualification/release condition remain explicitly pending. Stage acceptance and commit depend on this original finish gate.
